items.headline: Miller, Ison lead ground game and Toledo slips past Sacramento State 20-17
items.description: — CJ Miller ran for 135 yards, Autavius Ison had 101 yards and a touchdown, and Toledo defeated Sacramento State 20-17 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Richter, Miller lead Toledo's offensive show in 45-38 win over Western Michigan
items.description: — John Alan Richter threw for three touchdowns and ran for another as Toledo pulled out a 45-38 win over Western Michigan on Saturday for the Rockets' fourth straight victory.
